title: Assertion failed: saved_copyID != copyID && saved_copyID != copyID - 1

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

body:
- notice that this seems like a dup of isssu 12387, reopening new issue per the request at issue 12387
- NVIM v0.5.0-dev (git sha 91e41c857)
- `vim -u DEFAULTS` (version: ): don't know if repro
- OS: CentOS Linux release 7.6.1810 (Core)
- Terminal name/version: Alacritty
- `$TERM`: screen-256color

### Steps to reproduce using `nvim -u NORC`
not known
